Simulate one mapping population replicate

Source: R/mapping-sim.R
simulate_mapping_replicate.Rd

The engine behind mapping_population(). Exposed for checking and teaching: it returns the genotypes, phenotypes, QTL and scan as well as the outcomes.

Usage

simulate_mapping_replicate(args, seed, keep_data = FALSE)

Arguments

args

A full argument list, as built by mapping_population().

seed

Replicate seed.

keep_data

Return the simulated genotypes, phenotypes and LOD profile.

Value

A list of outcomes (power is 0 or 1 for one replicate), plus data when keep_data = TRUE.
